SubscribeSign inNvidia's H200, high-end A.I. Chip Increases its Dominance 

One chip to rule the world, "Grace Hopper Superchip" - H200 

Michael SpencerNov 15, 2023∙ Paid204ShareHey Everyone, 

If you want to read about Nvidia’s progress and future in 2023, this is the article for you. 

I read a lot of valuation metrics and Nvidia certainly has stolen the headlines from OpenAI in the second half of 2023 when it comes to its relative importance in Generative A.I.’s evolution heading into 2024. While we have covered it before, it’s time to cover Nvidia’s new A.I. chip again in more detail and the unique epicenter of the hardware side of A.I. 

Nvidia can maintain its A.I. chip dominance for a number of reasons. Nvidia’s investment in the the future of the Cloud, Metaverse, Quantum computing and Generative A.I. is now getting pretty obvious. The way they are able to anticipate the future, just feels different. 

And they are starting to have the revenue to prove it. I wanted to share some interesting videos, infographics, summaries and insights today about Nvidia. 

Is Big Tech monopolizing the AI boom?

Michael Spencer and Charlie Guo·November 14, 2023Read full storyCharlie Guo made this infographic and you can see Nvidia’s investment diversification is very well represented in the next generation of A.I. companies. 

How Nvidia has navigated the A.I. chip bans in China is also rather expert. Its official launch of its H200, its newest high-end chip for training AI models, is really our main focus for today. 

But we will be examining Nvidia from many angles.
